gameDescriptionHtml:
All hands on deck for an island-hopping adventure starring Mario and Luigi! The brothers return for a brand-new adventure on the high seas! When the Uni-Tree is destroyed and the world of Concordia is broken apart, Mario and Luigi must try to reconnect a fractured world, one island at a time.

Game Features

  • Welcome aboard! Set sail with Mario and Luigi on Shipshape Island (part ship, part island) to search for the drifting islands of Concordia. When the brothers work together, you never know what you might find!
  • Sail! Plot your course on the Ocean Map, looking for points of interest like islands, reefs, and tiny islets. You can choose the order you visit islands in, and your approach to the challenges you’ll face, as you chart your path through the story!
  • Explore! When you spot an island, launch out of Shipshape’s cannon to explore a range of locations from tropical rainforests to bustling cities. Meet the locals, solve puzzles, fight baddies, and more.
  • Link! Overcome each island’s unique challenges to form an island link with your ship. The more islands you reconnect, the more fun discoveries you’ll unlock, like side quests and access to new areas!
  • Bro Power! Unleash the mighty power of Mario and Luigi’s brotherly bond to overcome adversity and thwart foes! Use Bros. Moves to get past obstacles while you explore, and powerful Bros. Attacks in a dynamic twist on turn-based combat. You’ll need every edge this “brothership” will give you to save the day.
  • Team up to battle… and explore! When Mario and Luigi are together, they can work as a team to attack. Mario and Luigi can also team up to explore challenging locations. When the Bros. work together, they can overcome all sorts of obstacles!
  • Bros. Attacks! Take advantage of powerful Bros. Attacks like Zapperator in a dynamic twist on turn-based combat, where well-timed attacks, dodges, and counterattacks are key to defeating foes!
  • Battle Plugs! Equip Battle Plugs for extra abilities, like guaranteed critical hits against flying targets, to get a strategic advantage on your enemies. Swap Battle Plugs whenever you want, and experiment with creative combinations to create different effects
  • Bros. Moves! Use Bros. Moves to bypass obstacles while you explore by turning into a ball or UFO, or even throwing fire and ice balls to melt or freeze something in your way.
  • Solve puzzles and more! Work together to solve puzzles and interact with the world of Concordia.
  • Luigi Logic! Whether in battle or out exploring, you can unleash the power of Luigi’s, er, inventive mind to come up with solutions to save the day.
  • Meet the crew! You’ll encounter new friends along the way, like Connie and Snoutlet (definitely not a pig). You’ll also bump into some familiar faces from the Mushroom Kingdom like Peach and Bowser, who may help—or hinder—you on your journey!
